sentences.en: Walnuts, almonds, hazelnuts, pistachios and pine nuts are dry fruits.
sentences.zh: 核桃、杏仁、榛子、开心果和巴旦木都是干果。

sentences.en: Sherie is cooking some calves’ liver in almond saffron sauce.
sentences.zh: 谢莉正在用杏仁藏红花酱烹制一些牛肝。

sentences.en: A single almond needs one gallon of water to grow.
sentences.zh: 种植一颗杏仁需要一加仑的水。
